lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Nd4Mg8 (reduced formula Cs2NdMg2) is orthorhombic, space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Cs centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Cs, 2 Mg, 2 Nd), Mg centers also have 12 neighbors (4 Cs, 4 Nd, 4 Mg), and Nd centers have 12 Cs neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face contacts, and Cs–Mg polyhedra with corner and face sharing.
